'''Ulla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who offered her services to the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Galactic War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|outbreak]] of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], she [[Mission to the Lost Island|transported]] a Republic strike team to [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]]'s [[Lost Island]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ulla appears as the starting NPC for Republic players to begin the Lost Island Flashpoint, which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.2.<ref name="TOR" />
